concerns.text: Task T005a is marked [X] (complete) but the Analyze Report flags the artifact `contracts/trajectory.schema.yaml` as missing. Since T017 and T033 depend on this schema for validation, the implementation of these downstream tasks is blocked. A task marked complete must have its artifact present.

Task T005b is marked [X] (complete) but the Analyze Report flags the artifact `contracts/metrics.schema.yaml` as missing. This violates the plan's requirement for SSoT metric definitions and blocks downstream evaluation tasks.

Task T013 (download_cherrl_logs.py) is marked [ ] (incomplete) and the Analyze Report confirms the script and `data/raw/cherrl_logs/` are missing. This is a hard blocker for all downstream tasks (T014–T038) that require input data. The task must be implemented to satisfy FR-001 and US-1.

Task T025 (contaminated window exclusion) is marked [ ] (incomplete). The Analyze Report notes a contradiction: the task description claims to output a DataFrame column, but the verifier expects a missing `baseline_mask.json`. Regardless of the output format, the task is unimplemented, blocking T022 (flagging logic) which requires the mask to calculate the baseline noise floor per FR-009.

Tasks T032a, T032b (independence checks) and T031 (ground truth derivation) are marked [ ] (incomplete). The Analyze Report confirms the `independence_check_status.json` file is missing. This leaves the critical statistical independence gate (FR-006, FR-008) open, preventing valid ground truth generation per FR-004.

Tasks T016 (aggregation) and T023 (labeling) are marked [ ] (incomplete). The Analyze Report confirms `trajectories_divergence.csv` and `trajectories_labeled.csv` are missing. These are required outputs for US-1 and US-2 respectively.

Task T003a (linting config) is marked [X] but the Analyze Report flags `.ruff.toml` as missing. This violates the plan's requirement for linting configuration and Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene).

Task T033 (Stratified Random Baseline) is marked [ ] (incomplete). This task is required for FR-005 (Wilcoxon test against baseline) and SC-002. Without it, the statistical significance evaluation cannot proceed.

Tasks T034a (Wilcoxon test), T035 (SC-003 check), T037 (sensitivity analysis), and T038 (final report) are all marked [ ] (incomplete). These are required to satisfy FR-005, FR-007, SC-001, SC-002, SC-003, and US-3. The evaluation phase is entirely unimplemented.

Tasks T040a, T040b (refactoring), T042 (edge case tests), and T043 (quickstart validation) are marked [ ] (incomplete). While some are polish, T042 covers edge cases critical for robustness (zero variance, missing data) mentioned in the spec's Edge Cases section.
